response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack software engineer (15+ years) with strong web, backend, and testing expertise, but the role requires deep hardware-oriented specialization — SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance architecture, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, and hardware-software co-design — none of which appear anywhere in the resume. Experience is almost exclusively in web platforms (Node.js, TypeScript, D, Ember), with only tangential low-level exposure via C/C++ work at National Instruments a decade ago and a wave-field-synthesis thesis project. There is no evidence of deep neural network training/inference optimization, performance modeling of accelerators, or silicon architecture collaboration, and the educational path (BS CS) would require 8+ years of relevant technical experience, which is not met in this domain. This is a fundamental domain mismatch rather than a seniority gap.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering with demonstrated seniority (Staff/Senior roles)
Some low-level and performance-sensitive work (C/C++ at NI, low-latency D microservices at scale)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, teaching and public speaking
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, RTL, or hardware architecture experience whatsoever
No AI accelerator, GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or deep-learning workload optimization background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, not systems architecture or hardware-software co-design

key_factors.factor: SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
AI/deep-learning workload and accelerator optimization expertise
General senior software engineering depth and longevity
